scope: 最先认可的3张样例，现已随完整21张批次替换正式资源。

entries.title: 热石上的薄饼
entries.review: 保留递饼动作、热石、牧羊人和羊群；人物与布料以连续色块表达，暖色食物与冷色环境分明。
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the supplied event illustration in the clean flat-color fantasy comic style of the second image.
Image 1 = content/composition target, event 205 "Flatbread on a Hot Stone". Image 2 = ONLY the approved linework, color and shading reference. Do not reproduce Image 1's realistic painterly texture or Image 2's individual adventurer/costume/tavern.
Preserve Image 1's landscape 3:2 aspect ratio and story: a warm, smiling elderly shepherd woman with gray hair under an ivory kerchief offers a fresh flatbread to a tired adult traveler; two companions and curious sheep watch; several flatbreads bake on a broad heated stone over a low fire in the foreground beside a rural road. Preserve the important hand-to-bread interaction, sheep silhouettes and hospitable mood. Simplify the distant landscape and settlement into low-detail shapes so the main interaction dominates.
Fully REDRAW as hand-inked 2D fantasy comic art: fine dark organic outlines, a few purposeful inner lines for folds and hair, expressive simplified faces, believable stylized adult anatomy, broad uninterrupted matte flat colors. Match the approved reference's clean surface finish. Each material gets one clear base color and a small number of crisp cel-shadow shapes. Use no all-over texture. Wool is a clean ivory silhouette with a few curving strokes, skin smooth flat warm peach/copper, cloth smooth teal/brick-red/cream shapes, leather clean russet brown. Keep the older woman's age through facial shape and a few expression lines rather than many wrinkles.
Fresh clear daylight colors: teal and cool green clothing/foliage contrasted with warm brick-red garments and golden flatbread, muted blue mountain silhouettes. Preserve each actor's distinct costume; do not turn everyone into the reference adventurer. Sparse short cream steam shapes, simple orange fire shapes, no glow. Reduce background detail and draw rocks, leaves and wood as large clean shapes.
Full bleed to all edges. No text, UI, border, title, speech bubbles, signatures or watermark. Avoid painterly blending, mottled grunge, paper/parchment grain, speckled rocks, realistic texture, dense hatchwork, heavy outlines, muddy brown wash, cinematic shading, volumetric rays, 3D rendering or photorealism. This is a clean comic redraw, not a photo filter or a textured painting.

entries.title: 一锅汤的赎金
entries.review: 保留三只哥布林、被举起的汤勺、汤锅、厨师与谈判中的旅人；冲突尚未解决，表情与动作清晰。
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create a clean fantasy comic REDRAW of Image 1, keeping its event and landscape 3:2 framing. Image 1 is the content/composition target for event 214 "A Pot of Soup as Ransom". Image 2 is ONLY the approved style reference for thin hand-inked lines, smooth flat colors, expressive faces and simple cel shading.
Preserve the comic standoff: three small green forest goblins have stopped a traveling cook's covered wooden cooking wagon. One goblin on a crate raises the cook's oversized soup ladle triumphantly; a second goblin nervously stirs the large orange soup cauldron with a plain wooden stirrer to stop it burning; a third crouches near the wagon. An indignant adult cook in an ivory apron and rust-red blouse glares at them with hands on hips; two weary adult travelers on the right gesture in negotiation. Keep the wagon, large soup pot, raised ladle, three goblins and readable gestures. No resolution yet: no payment, no combat, the goblin still holds the ladle.
Rendering must look like Image 2 rather than Image 1. Clean smooth skin and cloth, expressive angular faces, dark thin slightly organic outlines, sparse purposeful strokes. Each material uses broad uninterrupted base-color shapes plus one or two clear hard-edged shadow shapes. Completely remove the painterly speckling, grungy stains and patchy surface noise from the original. Clean ivory apron and canvas canopy, smooth warm brown wood and leather, vivid yellow-green/teal goblin skin, muted forest-teal background, rust-red and blue garments, golden-orange soup as the warm focal accent. Age and wear only in a few contour nicks and seams, never all-over distressed texture. Goblins should have amusing lively expressions and readable anatomy, not realistic monster skin.
Simplify the forest into layered large foliage silhouettes and a few defined trunks. Reduce extra clutter and tiny leaf detail; retain important pots, vegetables and crates as clean shapes. Steam is a few simple pale cream curves, fire is flat orange shapes, no volumetric glow. Preserve facial readability in the woodland shade and the humorous storytelling.
Full bleed single 2D illustration, no border, writing, UI, speech bubble, title, logo or watermark. Avoid dense hatching, thick heavy black contours, paper grain, distressed parchment, muddy brown washes, mottled stone, realistic skin texture, painterly gradients, cinematic lighting, photo/3D appearance. Do not transplant the reference adventurer, his identity or tavern.

entries.title: 篝火旁的空座
entries.review: 保留空树墩、递出的杯子与尚未入座的主角；深蓝夜色与暖色人物区分，人物表情可读。
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw Image 1 using the approved clean flat-color comic style of Image 2. Produce ONE full-bleed landscape 3:2 event illustration.
Image 1 is the narrative and composition target for event 218 "The Empty Seat by the Campfire"; Image 2 is a style reference ONLY. Preserve the quiet invitation that has not yet been accepted: a traveler seen from behind in the left foreground hesitates at the edge of a welcoming camp. A smiling adult red-haired woman extends a steaming metal cup toward that traveler; an EMPTY tree-stump seat with a folded red cloth sits prominently in the lower center. A bearded companion, an older gray-haired man and a younger adult traveler wait with friendly understanding around a small fire on the right; the camp dog rests beside them, a simple tent and pine forest behind. Keep the seat visibly unoccupied and the cup still in the woman's hand. Preserve distinct faces, ages and costumes and the emotional composition; do not replace them with the reference character.
Redraw from the ground up as clean hand-inked fantasy comic art: thin dark organic contour lines, sparse short interior strokes, expressive simplified faces and believable adult anatomy. Smooth opaque flat colors, mostly one base color plus one crisp shadow per material. Remove the original's pervasive mottled paint marks, grain, scuffed leather patterns, busy bark and hair texture. Cloaks and skin should be broad clean color shapes. Fur and hair use a few defined tufts, not realistic individual strands. Wood has a few deliberate structure lines only.
Night palette: clearly layered indigo and muted violet-blue forest silhouettes, clean teal/navy cloaks contrasted with warm rust-red hair/scarf/cloth and ivory shirts, restrained golden fire and cup highlights. Keep all faces bright enough to read, with warm local color and simple shadow shapes, avoiding an overall orange-brown wash. Preserve night rather than making daytime. Fire is a small clean graphic orange/yellow shape; no bloom, volumetric glow, flying ember clutter or dramatic rim lighting. Steam a couple of thin ivory curves. Simplify distant foliage and the tent to support the characters, cup and empty seat.
Match Image 2's clean surfaces, line discipline and limited shading, NOT Image 1's realistic painterly finish. No grain, grunge, parchment texture, dense crosshatching, heavy black borders, muddy tones, 3D, glossy highlights, photorealistic anatomy/rendering, soft painterly blending, UI, captions, letters, frames, signatures or watermarks. No added people or props, and no change to the story outcome.
